triage.candidate: Per-call authorization needs durable evaluated-permission evidence
triage.researchQuestion: When a tool is available to an agent, which call-time runtime fact should decide run, deny or human review for this exact invocation?
triage.selectionReason: The mechanism is concrete, but the underlying separation of capability availability from call-time authority is already represented by the September 2 layered-connector authority object; today's allow/ask/deny evidence adds implementation detail without a sufficiently new research question.

triage.candidate: Persistent coordinators separate project management from implementing workers
triage.researchQuestion: What project-scoped state, delegation boundary and host handoff must a persistent coordinator own when workers execute long-running tasks across cloud and local machines?
triage.selectionReason: The persistent manager/worker separation is a bounded and relevant mechanism, but today it is supported by one vendor announcement and needs independent implementation, comparative failure or measured evidence before selection.

triage.candidate: Long-running threads need request-boundary policy refresh and snapshot-bound child inheritance
triage.researchQuestion: When authoritative instructions change during a long-running thread, at which execution boundary must the runtime re-admit policy and which applied snapshot should children and reviewers inherit?
triage.selectionReason: The implementation exposes a high-value policy-freshness boundary and distinct child/reviewer snapshot semantics, but one maintainer implementation is not yet enough for the preferred independent/comparative evidence gate.

triage.candidate: Recovery must distinguish produced, delivered and replayable tool results
triage.researchQuestion: Which separate delivery facts are required so a resumed HITL turn neither loses a locally produced result nor redelivers a server-owned result?
triage.selectionReason: Produced-versus-delivered evidence is useful implementation detail, but the underlying durable completion/replay-safety problem is already an established Research Center line and was explicitly de-duplicated in the September 9-10 Queue decisions.

triage.candidate: Deterministic order-invariant management for decomposable compound LLM systems
triage.researchQuestion: Which multi-agent management decisions can be replaced by a deterministic order-invariant operator, and what observability/coupling conditions bound that replacement?
triage.selectionReason: Primary research supplies a reusable deterministic mechanism, quantitative comparisons, provenance, explicit residual work and measurable negative conditions, making the boundary between semantic and deterministic management directly testable.

triage.candidate: Pluggable rule/LLM policy over stable executor and provenance-monitor boundaries
triage.researchQuestion: Can an agentic workflow compare rule and LLM orchestration without changing execution and provenance semantics underneath the policy layer?
triage.selectionReason: This is strong primary research with stable executor/provenance boundaries and measured rule-versus-LLM behavior, but the single Industry slot goes to UnitBoost's sharper test of when a generative manager is unnecessary and its explicit failure conditions.

triage.candidate: Relation-guided non-destructive organization of long-term agent memory
triage.researchQuestion: How can a long-lived agent change which memories are active or primary under equivalence, subsumption and conflict without destroying the observations needed for audit, reversal or reinterpretation?
triage.selectionReason: The primary study gives a distinct evidence-preserving memory-governance mechanism with quantitative retrieval/answer effects and a clear destructive-mutation failure mode that is different from recent migration and task-scoped clearance questions.

reading.workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects and produced two durable Reading Notes. Q-20260911-01 read the complete ROAM primary study across immutable atomic-memory representation, five-way relation taxonomy, deterministic relation precedence, Primary/Evidence role transitions, fused retrieval views, conflict and temporal updates, LongMemEval/MEME-Post/controlled-confounder evaluation, baseline comparisons, ablations, context-budget behavior and limitations. The bounded finding is that long-term agent memory should preserve source observations more durably than the model's current semantic interpretation: atomic evidence can remain immutable while Primary/Evidence roles and active retrieval views change, so source identity, semantic relation judgment, retrieval authority and recovery history should remain separate state identities. Non-destructive storage does not prove that demoted evidence remains equally visible at answer time, and memory-QA performance does not prove authorization or organizational truth. Q-20260911-02 read the complete UnitBoost primary study across unit abstraction, constrained deterministic selection, order-invariance, provenance, residual construction, later-round targeting, six compound-system configurations, held-out benchmarks, FanOutQA results, explicit negative conditions, coupling/repair-cost analysis and limitations. The bounded finding is that deterministic coordination can replace generative management only where stable work units, admissibility constraints and sufficiently weak coupling are observable; deterministic selection improves reproducibility and provenance but does not by itself prove semantic correctness, authorization or effect safety. The exact two-note head 963a8db696999d8c72fe334c8f5f5150b16b745b passed Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34558173003 with completed/success before terminal finalization. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
reading.workResult_zh: 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading，并生成两份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260911-01 完整深读 ROAM 一手研究的 Immutable Atomic Memory Representation、五类 Relation Taxonomy、确定性 Relation Precedence、Primary/Evidence Role Transition、Fused Retrieval View、冲突与时间更新、LongMemEval/MEME-Post/受控干扰项评测、Baseline Comparison、Ablation、Context-budget 行为与限制。边界结论是：长期 Agent Memory 应当让 Source Observation 比模型当前的 Semantic Interpretation 更难被改变；Atomic Evidence 可以保持不可变，而 Primary/Evidence Role 与 Active Retrieval View 可以变化，因此 Source Identity、Semantic Relation Judgment、Retrieval Authority 与 Recovery History 应保持为不同状态身份。Non-destructive Storage 不等于被降级的 Evidence 在 Answer Time 仍具有同等可见性，Memory-QA 成绩也不能被扩大成 Authorization 或 Organizational Truth 的证明。Q-20260911-02 完整深读 UnitBoost 一手研究的 Unit Abstraction、Constrained Deterministic Selection、Order-invariance、Provenance、Residual Construction、后续轮次定向、6 个 Compound-system Configuration、Held-out Benchmark、FanOutQA 结果、显式 Negative Condition、Coupling/Repair-cost 分析与限制。边界结论是：只有在 Stable Work Unit、Admissibility Constraint 与足够弱的 Coupling 可观察时，Deterministic Coordination 才适合替代 Generative Management；确定性选择可以提高可复现性与 Provenance，但本身不能证明 Semantic Correctness、Authorization 或 Effect Safety。精确两份 Note Head 963a8db696999d8c72fe334c8f5f5150b16b745b 已在终态收口前通过 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 34558173003，状态 completed/success。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
